name: Brechin Community Pantry
short_description: Community pantry providing emergency food support
description: Independent community pantry at 7 Swan Street. Open Mon
image: Fri 10am-1pm. Provides food parcels and signposting to local services. Self-referral welcome.

name: Brechin Community Garden
short_description: Volunteer-run community garden with free produce
description: Run by 10 volunteers who grow fruit and veg for the community. Located near town centre. Open for produce collection with optional donations. Tesco and Co-op donations also available.
